Name: The weather today is falling paper
Author: Asterisk555
Description:
No need to study today folks! All the books have ascended to a higher plane.

Makes paper drift across the screen by replacing petals and falling leaves using CP. Simple mod I made for fun. The location in the background is the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/6317]Town School[/url] mod.

If you want to test this mod immediately after installing type 'debug debrisweather' in the SMAPI console and move around a bit. There a delay of a few seconds. For other debugging commands see [url=https://stardewvalleywiki.com/Modding:Console_commands]Console commands[/url] on the stardew wiki.﻿

Thanks to Tiakall for comissioning the original art to use in [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/10950]Jorts and Jean the Helper Cats[/url] and has generously not claimed exclusive rights, so anyone can use this art in their mods if they credit me as the original artist.
